newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KPN confirms it mulling listings split.
newsitem.headline: KPN confirms it mulling listings split.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Wednesday it was examining the possibility of separate listings for its post and telecoms arms.

KPN Chairman Wim Dik told the Wall Street Journal newspaper on Tuesday that the company was considering a situation under which KPN would become a holding company for separately traded postal and telecoms units.
"It's very loose and there is no hurry. That's all we can say about it," said a KPN spokesman confirming the company was looking at the possibilities.
"We have a duty to the shareholders to look into (the possibility of separate stock listings). But there is no haste," Dik told the newspaper.

Dik qualified his remarks by saying: "If you're lucky enough to have telephone and postal activities in one company you'd need a pretty good reason to split them. There is simply no such good reason to do so at KPN."
Asked about a possible time-frame for any move the KPN spokesman said: "We can't say that, we won't say that."
